h1: Tube laser cutters — two- and three-chuck, Ø0.3″ to 14″, 20 to 39 ft bars, 1.5 to 40 kW
intro: A tube laser cutter holds the bar in two chucks — three on the zero-tail versions — turns and feeds it under the head and cuts lengths, holes, copes, slots and notches from the 3D model in one pass, with no saw, drill, notcher or layout; the bundle loader feeds the next bar. For tube to Ø14″ it is the machine most shops need. NovoTech sells two lines in Canada, both on this page: the premium Dener E-FTL made in Turkey, with 1 G servo chucks for Ø0.3″ to 13.8″ at 394 ft/min and ±0.05 mm, 3 to 20 kW; and the value line — NovoTech's own ULT with two or three pneumatic chucks for Ø0.4″ to 14.2″ on 20, 29.5 or 39 ft bars with 1.5 to 40 kW, the two-chuck T series from Ø0.5″ and 1.5 kW, and the high-speed PLUS and ±45° bevel-cutting GPLUS / GT. Every model is in the table below with its tube range, power, speed and bar length, then each family with its full specification, photos and brochure. Every machine comes with a CSA-approved panel, chiller and tube nesting software, installed, trained and supported from Mississauga, ON, Canada. For beams and pipe to Ø25″ and 49 ft see the heavy-duty tube lasers.

faq.q: What can a tube laser cut?
faq.a: Round, square, rectangular, oval and open profiles — angle, channel, flat bar — in mild steel, stainless, aluminum, copper and brass, from the chuck's minimum to its maximum size, in wall thicknesses to about 1/2″ (12 kW) or 3/4″ (20 kW). Holes, slots, copes for tube-to-tube joints, tabs and notches for folding, engraving — anything you can draw on the surface of the profile. A 5-axis or 45° bevel head adds weld preparations and mitred corners.

With two chucks the rear chuck has to keep hold of the bar, so the last few inches of every bar are scrap. The three-chuck ULT adds a chuck that takes over the bar as it shortens and cuts the last part with no remnant — on 20 to 39 ft bars of stainless or heavy-wall tube that saves material on every bundle. It is built on the 024, 028 and 036 chucks.

The premium E-FTL is built by Dener in Turkey with 1 G servo chucks, Precitec heads and ±0.05 mm, with Dener Canada parts in Mississauga, ON, Canada — for the shop that runs the tube laser all day. NovoTech's value-line ULT and the T / PLUS / GT are built in China with pneumatic chucks, in more sizes and powers at a lower price; NovoTech stocks the parts and does the service. The premium machine is faster between parts and holds tighter tolerance at high duty.

The number is the largest round tube in millimetres: E-FTL 120 takes Ø0.3 – 4.7″, 180 to 7.1″, 250 to 9.8″ and 350 to 13.8″; FTL 250, 350, 500 and 640 take Ø0.6″ to 9.8, 13.8, 19.7 and 25.2″. Square and rectangular tube is limited by the diagonal, so a 350 chuck takes about 9.8″ square. Buy the chuck for the largest tube you cut regularly — a smaller chuck is faster and holds thin tube better — and the bar length (7, 9 or 12 m) for the stock you buy.

From a bundle: the automatic loader separates one bar, measures it and feeds it to the rear chuck; the front chuck and following supports hold the bar as it is cut; finished parts drop onto the unloading table or conveyor and the remnant is ejected. One operator runs the machine while loading the next bundle. Loading lengths of 7, 9 and 12 m — or manual loading on the small Senfeng T series.

faq.q: Can it cut bevels and weld preparations?
faq.a: Yes — the 5-axis head on the FTL (optional on the E-FTL) tilts to ±45° so mitred corners, chamfers and weld preparations are cut in the same pass as the holes and copes; the tube arrives at the welding table ready to fit. The seam detector orients welded tube so the seam sits where the drawing puts it.

The CNC imports STEP / IGES solid models of the tube parts, unfolds them onto the profile, nests them along the bar to use the remnant and writes the program — with the cutting database for the material and seam detection to orient welded tube. Offline programming on a PC is standard on both lines.

A 7 m machine needs about 20 m (65 ft) of length including the loader and unloader; a 12 m machine about 30 m. 600 V 3-phase with the supplied transformer or 480 V, a chiller (included), assist gas and a dust collector. We lay the machine out for your building before you order.

faq.q: What voltage do these machines run on?
faq.a: Three-phase machines are supplied for 600 V as standard with a CSA-approved panel; 208 V, 240 V and 480 V 3-phase are available on request, and 240 V single-phase on models with a small enough motor. Manual machines have no electrics.
